Chapter 6907: High Heaven’S Wrath

Chapter 6907: High Heaven’s Wrath

“Do you dare to face the heaven’s wrath?” Fire Immortal challenged.

Despite having fallen to the darkness, he still stated his intention clearly instead of a sneak attack.

“Of course.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Very well, this wrathful flame is from the high heaven, it can incinerate a true immortal.” Fire Immortal said.

“That’s news to me.” Li Qiye said: “How did you survive then if this flame can kill a true immortal?”

The others paused for a second. Everyone knew his flame was incredible, feared even by golden immortals. However, the exact level remained unknown.

“This so-called wrathful flame is only a part of a tribulation proportional to your cultivation, not reaching the villainous heaven’s level.” Li Qiye continued.

“Try it first, then talk!” Fire Immortal shouted, releasing an inferno from his eyes wielding the rage of the high heaven.

It immediately extinguished stars and could blind regular immortals.

“Ahh!” Fire Immortal bellowed in agony. He had always contained it within his dao. Thus, releasing a high quantity meant being burned by it repeatedly.

“High Heaven’s Wrath, Blast!” He condensed the inferno together. Once it reached the limit, it turned into two unprecedented blazing lightning bolts.

One burned ten million years into the past and the other, ten million years into the future. They burned the karma accumulated throughout the years, ending cycles entirely.

Grand immortals shuddered in horror, unable to block the flames from eradicating everything about them. They thought that even if this move couldn’t kill him, it should leave a hole in his body.

Alas, they became disappointed after the bolts hit him and disappeared like embers splashed by water.

“How can this be?!” Fire Immortal staggered backward, unable to believe his eyes.

“What?!” The others felt the same way, having witnessed the might of the two blazing bolts.

“Looks fake, no?” Li Qiye patted his robe and nonchalantly said.

Fire Immortal’s expression changed continuously, still in disbelief.

“What kind of body is this?” Guangmai stared intensely at Li Qiye. The mortal had just endured tribulation bolts without activating anything.

“Ordinary Me Physique.” Li Qiye said.

“Ordinary Me Physique?” Guangmai murmured before stating: “Did you just make this up?”

He had never heard of such a physique before, despite being a primordial immortal.

“It’s alright if you think so, I did choose the name.” Li Qiye waved with a smile.

Guangmai started thinking about the greatest beings in existence. The strongest included Dust and Heavenfall. The next step was the mythical octopus.

However, this mortal was not clearly any of them.

“Is this all your alliance can do?” Li Qiye taunted.

The immortals have never felt this awkward and humiliated before, being taunted by a mortal despite being together in full force.

“Move, our turn!” Immortal Devourer shouted and stomped the air, summoning an abyss behind him.

“Devouring Abyss!” Everyone saw the dreadful abyss and shuddered.

After reaching the golden stage, Immortal Devourer refined his existing lineage into nothingness. He buried all the karma into the abyss and used the members’ life forces to nourish it.

“Go!” Big-foot, Netherlight, and Southconch channeled their dao power to activate it.

“I will devour immortals to become the heaven!” Immortal Devourer transformed into a cauldron.
